source: Norton & Karczub 2e Table 6.1, PDF page 430 (printed p. 410)
about: Eleven structural loss factors, which the table heads with the symbol eta_s and calls structural rather than internal: it is the loss of a structure made of the material, not of a coupon of it. The page sets every value as a mantissa times a power of ten, and two of the eleven as a range rather than a figure, which this catalogue keeps as a range. "Brick, concrete" is one printed row covering two materials and is kept as the page sets it rather than split into two rows this library would have invented. The table credits no source.
